label: D2 after a2 -> S2 (common), early in the episode
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires mainly at D2 when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition (87% of mass at D2, rate 16% on S2 inputs and near zero on S1). It never fires at D1 or on rewarded-input steps. A weak GO component (13% of mass) is not captured. Activity depends strongly on episode time: about 13% of steps in trials 0-9, falling to zero after trial ~70, so the a2/S2 D2 condition alone has precision of only 0.21. Adding ep_trial < 35 gives dev F1 0.64 and mass recall 0.76. Within a window, magnitude is largest on the first a2->S2c trial after a switch or after an unrewarded/rare trial, and it decays over consecutive repeated rewarded a2->S2c trials (e.g. 1.0, 0.47, 0.24). History predicates (prev_state != 2, etc.) did not beat the time cutoff. All variables are observed at D2. ep_trial is not an input, but the GRU state can drift with time.
